title: Run and Tell the City
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The city had no food to eat;
four men went out to see.
They reached the camp, and no one there!
God made the army flee!

[Chorus]
When you know something wonderful,
don’t keep it; go and share!
The best news is that God loves you,
so tell it everywhere!

[Verse 2]
They ate and ate till they were full,
then said, “This isn’t right.
This news is much too good to keep!”
They hurried back that night.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now snuggle in, you’re full and warm,
the good news tucked in tight.
Heavenly Father loves you, dear,
and stays with you tonight.

[Chorus]
mood: Skipping music. A bright, easy lilt under the voice, like feet hurrying home with something happy to tell, but never frantic. The chorus opens up warm and generous, the sound of a whole city being fed. By the last verse the lilt slows to a rock and sinks low, bellies full, the news delivered, the child drifting off.
